SELECT t.id, t.ucm_id, t.sr_id, t.sr_num, t.total_man_hour, t.pat_problems, t.pat_actions, t.pat_tests, t.status, t.current_person_name, t.type_key, t.parent_key, t.close_time, t.comment, t.sr_context, t.wo_context, t.attachments_context, t.parts_context, t.hours_context, t.created_by, t.created_date, t.modified_date FROM mvs_transaction_work_order t WHERE 1=1
and t.sr_Num like concat('%', #{srNum}, '%')
and t.status = #{status}
and t.type_key = #{typeKey}
and t.type_key IN
#{item}
and (t.wo_context::jsonb) ->> 'woNum' like concat('%', #{woNum}, '%')
and (t.wo_context::jsonb) ->> 'ownerName' like concat('%', #{ownerName}, '%')
and (t.sr_context::jsonb) ->> 'faultDesc' like concat('%', #{faultDesc}, '%')
and (t.sr_context::jsonb) ->> 'customerName' like concat('%', #{customerName}, '%')
and t.ucm_id IN
#{item}
AND TO_TIMESTAMP( (t.sr_context::jsonb ->> 'acceptanceTime')::bigint / 1000 ) >= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND TO_TIMESTAMP( (t.sr_context::jsonb ->> 'acceptanceTime')::bigint / 1000 ) <= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
AND TO_TIMESTAMP( (t.wo_context::jsonb ->> 'createdDate')::bigint / 1000 ) >= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{startDateOpen}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND TO_TIMESTAMP( (t.wo_context::jsonb ->> 'createdDate')::bigint / 1000 ) <= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{endDateOpen}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
AND TO_TIMESTAMP( (t.wo_context::jsonb ->> 'closeTime')::bigint / 1000 ) >= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{startDateClose}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND TO_TIMESTAMP( (t.wo_context::jsonb ->> 'closeTime')::bigint / 1000 ) <= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{endDateClose}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM v2_service_request sr WHERE sr.id = t.sr_id ) order by t.sr_num desc
